  import QtQuick 2.9
  import QtQuick.Controls 2.2

  Page {
      width: 600
      height: 400

      header: Label {
          text: qsTr("Page 2")
          font.pixelSize: Qt.application.font.pixelSize * 2
          padding: 10
      }

      Label {
          text: qsTr("You are on Page 2.")
          anchors.centerIn: parent
      }
  }
